name: discord-patch-bot
description: Bot Discord pentru update-uri automate la jocuri

scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build:ts
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.e2e.test.js dist/test/outboxE2E.functional.test.js
scripts.test:regression: npm run build && node --test dist/test/commands-regression.test.js dist/test/configValidator.test.js
scripts.precommit: npm run check && npm run audit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict && npm run build && node dist/scripts/check-syntax.js && node dist/scripts/check-no-comments.js && node dist/scripts/check-config.js && node dist/scripts/check-dependencies.js && node dist/scripts/check-rules-sync.js && node dist/scripts/check-db-indexes.js && node --test --test-reporter=spec dist/test/*.test.js
